description: This file defines message IDs and diagnostic message methods used within the MigraDoc PDF rendering component, providing localized error and status messages related to images, bookmarks, and other PDF rendering issues.

classes.name: MdPdfMsgId
classes.description: An enumeration of message identifiers used for PDF rendering diagnostics in MigraDoc.

classes.name: MdPdfMsgs
classes.description: A static class providing methods to generate diagnostic messages for the MigraDoc PDF renderer, based on the message IDs.

methods.name: NumberTooLargeForRoman
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a number is too large to be displayed as a Roman numeral.

methods.name: NumberTooLargeForLetters
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a number is too large to be displayed as letters.

methods.name: DisplayEmptyImageSize
methods.description: Generates a message indicating an image has an empty size.

methods.name: DisplayImageFileNotFound
methods.description: Generates a message indicating an image file could not be found.

methods.name: DisplayInvalidImageType
methods.description: Generates a message indicating the image has an invalid type.

methods.name: DisplayImageNotRead
methods.description: Generates a message indicating an image could not be read.

methods.name: PropertyNotSetBefore
methods.description: Generates a message indicating that a specific property must be set before calling a certain function.

methods.name: BookmarkNotDefined
methods.description: Generates a message indicating a specified bookmark is not defined in the document.

methods.name: ImageNotFound
methods.description: Generates a message indicating an image with the given name was not found.

methods.name: InvalidImageType
methods.description: Generates a message indicating the image type is invalid.

methods.name: ImageNotReadable
methods.description: Generates a message indicating an image could not be read, including an inner exception message.

methods.name: EmptyImageSize
methods.description: Generates a message indicating the image size is empty.

methods.name: ObjectNotRenderable
methods.description: Generates a message indicating only certain object types can be rendered freely.
